title: Model health gets a dashboard
summary:
A model-health dashboard joined the garden, Flux stopped trading steps for concurrency, and G4F projects got clearer signposts.

ElliotEtag added Model Monitor for image and text models, with health states, sortable request and error metrics, latency trends, and recent-error filtering.

Flux generation now uses four steps for every request instead of reducing the step count as concurrency rises.

The project lists now include gpt4free and its Python and JavaScript SDKs. Chat-project listings point to G4F Chat UI and note its image and video generation capabilities.

highlights.title: Watch model health
highlights.text: Check image and text model health, request success rates, errors, and latency trends in Model Monitor. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
